title: Integration of a Taylor polynomial
statement: Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space, let $p,m\in\mathbb N$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ have finite $p$th moment, with $m\le p$. For every function $\psi:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ and all $a,b\in\mathbb R$, $\int \sum_{j=0}^{m-1}\frac{\psi^{(j)}(a)}{j!}(bX)^j\,d\mu=\sum_{j=0}^{m-1}\frac{\psi^{(j)}(a)}{j!}b^j\int X^j\,d\mu$, where $\psi^{(j)}$ denotes the $j$th iterated derivative.
